subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this memory/context umbrella stay as one design item, or be split into scoped product/security issues for metrics visibility, session handoff, global recall scope, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining work defines new API, default, lifecycle, visibility, and privacy behavior across stable gateway and memory/session surfaces, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Split into scoped design items
options.body: Create separate design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, global recall scope, and restart preload so each gets privacy, default, upgrade, and validation criteria before implementation.

options.title: Keep this canonical umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point and require future PRs to state which slice they implement and how they avoid conflicting with existing memory and gateway surfaces.

options.title: Close only after replacement
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly decide narrower linked issues preserve every remaining requirement and this umbrella no longer adds routing value.

recommendation.title: Split into scoped design items
recommendation.body: Create separate design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, global recall scope, and restart preload so each gets privacy, default, upgrade, and validation criteria before implementation.
